test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the two signs in the given options, if interchanged, would NOT impact the correctness of the following equation?

3 × 5 + 3 - 18 ÷ 3 = 12
solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/877780cd83b655fb987f86923f8477afa823a6a81abebbdfafe27c4199c9e6e9.png] 

**Option 1) : × and +**

**Given equation : 3 × 5 + 3 - 18 ÷ 3 = 12**

**After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows:**

**⇒ 3 + 5 × 3 - __18 ÷ 3__ = 12**

**⇒ 3 + __5 × 3__ - 6 = 12**

**⇒ __3 + 15__ - 6 = 12**

**⇒ __18 - 6__ = 12**

**⇒ 12 = 12 (** [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] )

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : ÷ and + 

Given equation : 3 × 5 + 3 - 18 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows:

⇒ 3 × __**5 ÷ 3**__ - 18 + 3 = 12

⇒ __**3 × 1.66**__ - 18 + 3 = 12

⇒ __**5**__ - 18 __**+ 3**__ = 12

⇒ __**8**____** - 18**__ = 12

⇒ - 10 ≠ 12 ( [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] )

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : × and ÷ 

Given equation : 3 × 5 + 3 - 18 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows:

⇒ __**3 ÷ 5**__ + 3 - 18 × 3 = 12

⇒ 0.6 + 3 - __**18 × 3**__ = 12

⇒ __**0.6 + 3**__ - 54 = 12

⇒ __**3**____**.6 - 54**__ = 12

⇒ - 53.4 ≠ 12 ( [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] )

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : × and -

Given equation : 3 × 5 + 3 - 18 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows:

⇒ 3 - 5 + 3 × __**18 ÷ 3**__ = 12

⇒ 3 - 5 + __**3 × 6**__ = 12

⇒ __**3**__ - 5 __**+ 18**__ = 12

⇒ __**21**____** - 5**__ = 12

⇒ 16 ≠ 12 ( [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] )

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"× and +".**
